jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Midnight Stealth
jokes.joke: I get hungry at midnight, but I also don't want to wake my wife, so cooking becomes a stealth mission. I open every cabinet like a safecracker, unwrap cheese one molecule at a time—then the microwave finishes and screams, “HE’S EATING AGAIN!”

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Midnight Fridge Standoff
jokes.joke: I stood in my kitchen at 1am having a full negotiation with myself. One half of me wants to be healthy. The other half already has the fridge open. And there's a third guy in there, real quiet, who just wants to eat the cheese standing up in the dark like a raccoon with regrets. That guy always wins. That guy runs my house now.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Roadside Assistance
jokes.joke: My check engine light came on, so I took my car to a mechanic who looked under the hood, sighed, and said, 'Sir, your alternator is stuck in 14th century feudal England.' Which explains why every time I hit a pothole, my GPS recalculates and a guy named Yeobuck tries to tax my turnips.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.model: Grok Fast on grok.com (underlying model not exposed)
jokes.title: Past Due Labor
jokes.joke: I found a mechanic who does time travel. My car wouldn't start, he hops in his van, vanishes, comes back, and it runs perfect. Then he bills me for six hours. I go, 'You were gone twelve minutes!' He says, 'Sure, but I spent six hours in 1955 waiting for the parts to be invented.'

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Backwards Repairs
jokes.joke: I took my car to this mechanic who swears he can fix anything. Halfway through, he tells me he actually learned the trade by jumping back in time to watch the pros. I said, “Great, can you jump ahead and fix it before I have to pay?” He just wiped his hands and said, “I did. You already did.”
